pharm: Balsamic resin (inhalant, skin protectant, vehicle for podophyllin)
quick: 1 teaspoon (5 mL) in a pint of hot (not boiling) water, inhale vapour
summary: Benzoin is a balsamic resin. Compound benzoin tincture is used as a steam inhalation for congestion, as a skin protectant and adhesive under dressings, and as the vehicle for podophyllin wart paint.
indications: Skin protectant / adhesion aid under tape
